g.text: Exposure gradients within the high-exposure group
Manuscript event-study specification, 29 high-exposure occupations, 2022 reference. 95% occupation-clustered intervals.
The event specification has no differential trend; the pooled break model separately includes the manuscript’s exposure-specific trend.
Joint pre-period restrictions are reported in the supporting table; these are relative associations, not adoption effects.
